job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience, strong expertise in AWS, Python, and CI/CD pipeline implementation. Experience in React is a plus.Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Python and modern front-end frameworks.
Build and manage cloud-native architectures on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, etc.).
Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, and deployment.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
Ensure application performance, security, and scalability best practices.
Troubleshoot production issues and drive root cause analysis.

Required Skills:

3+ years of hands-on experience in Full Stack Development
Strong proficiency in Python and backend frameworks (Django/FastAPI/Flask)
Solid experience with AWS services and cloud deployment
Expertise in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline
Experience with databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB
Good knowledge of system design and microservices architecture

Good to Have:

Experience with React.js or other front-end frameworks
Exposure to Docker and Kubernetes
Knowledge of Terraform or Infrastructure as Code
